EFFORTLESSLY, MAEZY

Two sisters.
One shared love.

Maezy began with two sisters, Mariya and Zahabiya, and a shared love for jewellery. For them, a piece could transform an outfit, hold a memory, or make an ordinary day feel special.

The name draws from “mazy”—intricate and full of beautiful twists—and echoes the Greek “mazí”, meaning together. Thoughtfully curated fashion jewellery, with the look and feel of fine jewellery in an accessible, wearable form.

BEFORE YOU MAKE IT YOURS

A little more to know.

Delivery

The pre-launch catalogue allows approximately 5–14 business days for your order to reach you.

Pre-launch purchases & damaged pieces

The catalogue states that returns and exchanges are unavailable during the limited pre-launch. If a piece arrives damaged, contact Maezy promptly with photos or videos. Once verified, Maezy offers store credit for a future purchase.

See it before you choose it

Colours, stones and finishes may look different in photographs. Contact Maezy on Instagram for live images or videos in natural light before ordering.

Pre-launch pricing & availability

Prices shown are the catalogue MRPs in Indian rupees. The catalogue describes limited quantities; current stock and prices still need confirmation. Its 10% friends-and-family pre-launch offer is not automatically applied.
